hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.java) (mvn -q -DskipITs test) ;; esac; }

mvn -q spotless:apply && git add -u; if ! (mvn -q -DskipTests compile); then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"mvn compile failed - fix build errors before committing"}}'; fi

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$(basename "$f")" in pom.xml|application.yml) printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Editing a sensitive project file (pom.xml or application.yml) - please confirm."}}' ;; esac; }
hooks.statusMessage: Checking if this is a sensitive file...
